customer: Hi, so I run a little landscaping business here in Dunmore and I've been driving my midsize SUV for work for years, and I'm thinking about selling it to upgrade. Thing is, back in the spring we had that big storm and my driveway kind of turned into a pond for a day, and I'm pretty sure some water got onto the floor of the cabin, though it dried out and runs fine. The title's clean as far as I know, no flood brand or anything. Would you still look at it, or does that mess things up?
agent: Thanks for the details. Per our Flood-damaged cars article, vehicles with flood damage or a flood brand on the title count as branded, and we don't buy those (see Salvage and rebuilt titles). Since water got into the cabin, please mention that when you request an offer so it's taken into account.
